user: What is a mixture-of-experts language model? Answer in three sentences.
answer: A mixture-of-experts (MoE) language model is an architecture that employs multiple specialized sub-networks, known as experts, to process different parts of the input data. A gating mechanism dynamically routes each input token to a subset of these experts, allowing the model to activate only the most relevant components for a given task. This approach enables the model to scale to massive parameter counts while maintaining computational efficiency, as not all experts are active for every input.
